Samir / Maya —

Thanks for the redlines and the retention asks. I reviewed the DPA document and the redline set you sent. Below are our positions and a proposed compromise to keep the MAP timeline intact: 

DPA redlines (summary & Redwood position):
- Deletion on termination: Redwood will schedule and confirm deletion of customer-provisioned production data within 30 days. For backup retention, we will commit to immutable backups that are logically deleted within 90 days; we will provide certification of deletion upon request.
- Right to audit: we accept a limited, scoped audit once per 12 months with pre-approved auditor and mutually agreed scope. For most customers we provide SOC 2 plus targeted evidence; for deeper audits we propose a confidentiality addendum.
- Indemnity carve-out: we cannot accept open-ended indemnity for third-party acts. We will accept indemnity for Redwood gross negligence or willful misconduct and for proven breaches of our obligations.

KMS and key management:
- Hosted API: envelope encryption + unique per-customer encryption keys managed by Redwood; we can provide exportable logs of key rotations and access; however full BYOK is only supported in Redwood Private (VPC/on-prem) today.
- Private option: full BYOK customer-managed KMS is available and we can include HSM integration in the SOW.

Retention enforcement & sandbox separation:
- We will provision tenant-level retention policies. Sandbox traffic can be labeled and automatically pruned at the 14-day window you requested. Production default will remain configurable; 90-day rolling for tokens is feasible and we’ll show the enforcement during the canary.

SLA credits: Redwood can include a credits schedule tied to monthly uptime SLA; specifics to be handled in the commercial SOW (we can provide standard schedule in procurement summary).

Operational obligations and evidence delivery:
- SOC 2 Type 2 attestation: we will provide the PDF attestation by Sep 10.
- Evidence passport: we will compile a short evidence package (control mapping, sample logs, runbook screenshots) and upload to a secure drive.
- Audit logs export: verified CSV export within 48 hours of an authenticated request — we’ll test this during the canary.

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) Confirm SIG/CAIX workshop Sep 3 — Monica will run the intake and map owners.
2) Redwood legal to incorporate the agreed compromise into the DPA and return a signing-ready copy by Sep 08.
3) Technical canary plan between Sep 13–17; Monica to share runbook and acceptance tests.

I’ll attach a brief one-page procurement summary and the SIG matrix after the intake session.
